comments.author: robomartin
comments.story: Create an Inexpensive Flying Wing / Drone (2019)
comments.why: Long, detailed technical explanation of dynamic soaring
comments.text: Adding to that, here's slope soaring, which is really cool. I haven't really done a lot of this due to having to travel far to have access to this type of geography. Beautiful silent flight, no motors required. They do add motors to some of the planes just so you have backup in case you lose lift. Here's an excellent intro to the sport: [LINK] And then there's the absolutely crazy/demented --in a good way-- dynamic slope soaring. I have yet to experience this. This is the domain of sophisticated carbon fiber and top-quality components. You can find videos of planes exploding in flight due to loads. This is a long video with a detailed technical explanation of dynamic soaring: [VIDEO] 548 mph (882 kph) run: [LINK]

comments.author: chrisdalke
comments.story: Dynamic soaring as a means to exceed the solar wind speed
comments.why: Engineering of an RC glider flown at 519mph
comments.text: Similar dynamic slope soaring has been researched and demonstrated to dramatic affect by Spencer Lisenby and others: [VIDEO] . In the video I linked he describes how they engineered and flew a RC glider at a speed of 519mph. Makes a lot of sense that this could be applied on a larger atmospheric scale for spacecraft.
